title: Keep the glints and draw all water marks in one masked pass
context: The device check traced the noon regression to the roughly 50 glints per frame, each drawn with an image shader plus a colour filter. The owner wants the glints preserved and asked whether a fix could keep them.
options: one masked pass for all water marks (about 1 ms fixed cost)
a fragment shader that masks and tints each mark in one draw
outcome: One masked pass. The owner said "1ms cost is fine" and asked for the change to be built directly, without a new spec or mitosis run. Criterion 10.8 is amended from no saveLayer to exactly one, for the water marks. Built on branch fix/meadow-water-marks-one-pass (b4454b3d), PR #261.
